summary: The local issues.csv is byte-for-byte equal to issues.csv downloaded anonymously from Kaggle version 1. Its locally computed SHA256 and byte count also match the official Mendeley version-2 public file listing. A direct Mendeley binary download was blocked, so direct binary equality against a separately downloaded Mendeley file was not tested. Coverage and license-label discrepancies remain unresolved.

license.evidence: Version-2 landing-page licence and embedded dataset.snapshot.licence metadata.
license.caveat: The source requests appropriate credit, a license link and indication of changes, and notes that further permission may be required for identified third-party content.

comparison.interpretation: Cryptographic identity to the listed version-2 file is supported by its official published SHA256 and size, plus a fresh independently downloaded Kaggle member. This is not a claim that Mendeley binary bytes were directly retrieved.

kaggle.title: Help Desk Tickets (Mendeley Data)
kaggle.license_interpretation: The Kaggle CC0 label does not establish authority to remove the original CC BY 4.0 attribution obligations. Preserve the original Mendeley attribution and license; resolve the inconsistent mirror label before claiming CC0 or unrestricted redistribution.

archive.note: Archive hash identifies the downloaded ZIP response; repackaging can change it without changing member contents.

source_documentation.name: FEATURES.md
source_documentation.retrieved_from: FEATURES.md member of the pinned Kaggle version-1 archive
findings: The issues.csv section states that the dataset contains issues reported from January 2016 until March 2023.
issue_created is defined as the creation time of the issue; issue_resolution_date is its resolution time; last_change_date is its last update time.
wf_total_time is total processing time in seconds; wf_ and wfe_ fields are aggregations and calculations from issues_change_history.csv.
The issues_snapshot.csv section describes started and ended as assignee work-cycle boundaries, not replacements for issue creation time.
Data masking is described for marked fields and provider identifiers; the document does not explain pre-2016 issue_created values or document timestamp shifting.
The document does not establish a business-hours SLA calendar, pause policy, contractual thresholds or complete day-by-day coverage.

source_documentation.name: EXAMPLE.md
source_documentation.retrieved_from: EXAMPLE.md member of the pinned Kaggle version-1 archive
findings: The example explains workflow-state seconds calculated from change history and separate processing cycles per assignee.
It supplies no explanation for the discrepancy between the stated coverage period and pre-2016 issue creation timestamps.

coverage.supported_conclusion: The early timestamps are in the exact public Kaggle file whose hash matches Mendeley version 2, not an observed local alteration. They include Ticket rows, so restricting issue_type to Ticket alone does not remove the discrepancy.
unsupported_explanations_not_assumed: A different time-field definition of the advertised reporting period
Complete coverage of every day in the advertised period

method.runtime: Existing project .venv\Scripts\python.exe with standard-library urllib.request, zipfile, hashlib, csv and datetime; no dependency installation.
method.network_privacy: Only public source URLs were requested. No local data, hashes or code were sent to a search service or uploaded to any source. No authentication, credentials, access-control bypass or third-party search service was used.
method.identity_check: Recomputed local SHA256; computed SHA256 of the downloaded Kaggle archive and uncompressed issues.csv member; compared local and downloaded member bytes directly; compared both SHA256 values and sizes with Mendeley version-2 public metadata.
method.csv_check: Parsed UTF-8-sig CSV with csv.DictReader and newline preservation; counted data rows and fields; parsed all issue_created timestamps with datetime.fromisoformat, confirmed UTC offsets and counted dates before 2016-01-01 UTC.
method.documentation_check: Read FEATURES.md and the EXAMPLE.md workflow explanation from the public archive; checked their locally computed hashes against Mendeley's version-2 listing.
reproduction: GET the Mendeley version-scoped files API URL and record issues.csv file/content IDs, size and published SHA256.
GET Kaggle metadata and its explicitly version-1 download URL without credentials.
Read issues.csv from the ZIP and compute SHA256 locally; compare it and its byte length to the raw local file and Mendeley listing.
Perform direct local-bytes versus ZIP-member-bytes equality, with no newline or CSV normalization.
Inspect the public FEATURES.md and EXAMPLE.md members and confirm their hashes against Mendeley.
Remove only files created for this verification after recording evidence.

limitations: Mendeley direct binary retrieval was blocked. Identity to Mendeley is a cryptographic comparison with its official published checksum, not a fresh direct Mendeley byte comparison.
Identity of this file does not establish completeness of extraction, authentic business demand on zero-record days, provider-system correctness, or current-period representativeness.
The stated 2016-2023 coverage and observed 2007-2023 creation timestamps remain inconsistent; no causal explanation is supported by the inspected release documents.
Kaggle's CC0 label conflicts with the original release's CC BY 4.0. This verification does not establish the uploader's relicensing authority or legal clearance.
Public availability, masking and matching bytes do not establish privacy safety, permission for every third-party element, or approval to publish row-level data.
Source identity does not validate project SLA mappings, thresholds, clock semantics, forecasting assumptions or other operational policies.
Only issues.csv and the two documentation members were compared to Mendeley hashes; other dataset members were not audited.
The original provider database and linked research implementation were not audited; this evidence records the public listing and downloads observed on the verification date.
